contributions.detail: 8 handwritten rows (500+500+500+300+500+150+100+80) sum to EXACTLY 2,630.00 = cover line 1, whose THIS cell is written '2,630' with a superscript '00' and whose CUMULATIVE cell is written '2,630.' with a trailing dash; the LAST cell is empty (only report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide -- recorded cumulative). SUB-$50 TRAP OBSERVED: cover line 2 reports a 220.00 aggregate of contributions of $50.00 or less, never itemised; the rows were scored against line 1 alone, not against 2,630+220 = 2,850. The Carr form prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: DOES NOT RECONCILE, and the residual is the FILER'S -- no row was adjusted to close it and the printed 9,619.85 is untouched. The 23 inked rows as printed sum to 16,889.70. Excluding row 23 -- the candidate's own lump 'Campaign Expense' line, see its note -- the 22 vendor rows sum to 10,119.85, still 500.00 MORE than the cover's 9,619.85. The cause is traceable on the page: 9,619.85 = 2,850.00 (total contributions, line 1 + line 2) + 6,769.85 (row 23), and cover line 4 is written '- 0 -', so the filer DERIVED line 3 from the balance identity 'spend everything raised plus what I put in myself' rather than by adding Form B; row 23 is that self-funded plug, which double-counts against the vendor rows. The remaining 500.00 is an unexplained filer addition error. Every candidate for a mis-read 500 was escalated to 1200 dpi (604.42, 1,535.04, 1,804.78, 800.00, 833.00) and every glyph held; the one cent-level correction the escalation DID produce (67.96 -> 67.46) moved the vendor sum to a round 500.00 offset, which is itself evidence the residual is arithmetic, not transcription. ALL 23 rows carry needs_review:1. scope: LAST is blank and THIS == CUMULATIVE, and the rows span the whole 2014 cycle, so the row set is cumulative.

gates.page_subtotal: Neither Carr schedule prints a total or a page subtotal; the cover is the only anchor on both sides. Form A: rows 2,630.00 = cover line 1 -- GATES EXACTLY. Form B: rows 16,889.70 as printed (10,119.85 excluding the candidate's own summary line) vs cover line 3 9,619.85 -- WOULD NOT GATE under either reading; both figures named, no row adjusted.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 --dpi 200: status 'gaps', 33 bands on a ~2.31%-pitch grid; mapped by hand against ink: 8 amount-bearing rows (two of them, rows 1 and 5, have their contributor name wrapped over a second band that carries no amount), 8 emitted. p3: status 'gaps', 29 bands with two multi-pitch gaps (50.75->60.16 and 62.23->67.32) where rules were missed; ink counted by eye and cross-checked against the interpolated 2.27% pitch: 23 amount-bearing rows + 1 purpose-wrap band ('Convention-Primary' under row 3, no amount), 23 emitted. Nothing is inked below row 23.
gates.geometry_proof: Form B p3: the amount column was rendered as two tall 600 dpi strips covering every band from the header rule to below the last row, and the 23 values appear in the emitted order with no band skipped and no band doubled; the strips end in empty grid. Form A p2: each of the 8 emitted bands was located against the rowbands rule list and every one contains its own value (rows 1 and 5 sit on the SECOND band of a wrapped name, which is where the filer wrote the amount). No shifted index survives either check.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE, and the break is the filer's. Cumulative column: 2,630.00 + 220.00 - 9,619.85 = -6,769.85, but cover line 4 is written '- 0 -' (a glyph denoting zero = 0). The gap is exactly row 23 of Form B, the candidate's own 6,769.85 'Campaign Expense' -- money he put in that was never entered on Form A as a contribution, so the cover balances only if that self-funding is treated as receipts. Both figures transcribed verbatim; neither corrected. No prior filing by this filer in this chunk (the 2012 Buttars filing, key 42088268, is a DIFFERENT cycle and a different office), so no cross-filing cumulative chain was run.

escalation_note: The expenditure side would not close on the 200 dpi read, so the ENTIRE Form B amount column was re-rendered as two 600 dpi strips, then the five plausible 500.00-error cells (604.42, 1,535.04, 1,804.78, 800.00, 833.00) were cropped individually at 1200 dpi. Every one held its 200 dpi value. One cell DID change: row 12's cents read '96' at 200 dpi and '46' at 600 dpi (this filer's 6 is a small loop), giving 67.46. Per the Rhodes rule the arithmetic then governs: with the corrected value the vendor rows sit exactly 500.00 above the printed cover figure, a round offset that no further glyph reading can dissolve, so the side is published as a delta rather than 'settled' by another re-read. The cover money block was also cropped at 600 dpi to confirm 2,630 / 220 / 9,619.85 / '- 0 -'.
notes: THIS COVER IS A DIFFERENT PRINTING FROM THE OTHER CARR FORMS IN THE CHUNK: it cites 'the Cache County Code 2.21' instead of Utah Code 17-16-6.5, and page 4 prints Cache County Code 2.21.040/2.21.050 (the county's own summary-report and interim-report requirements) instead of the state statute -- same 5-5-PG Carr layout and the same four cover lines. Cover 'Name of Office' reads 'Cache County Executive' with the Office District line left EMPTY; the chunk file's office 'County Executive' AGREES (note this is the SAME candidate as key 42088268, who filed for Cache County Council in 2012 -- a different office in a different cycle, so the two filings must not be chained). Candidate 'Craig "W" Buttars'; chunk says 'Buttars' -- agrees. Cover date 10/27/2014, clerk RCVD stamp 27 OCT 2014; the chunk's date column says 2014-10-28 -- the DOCUMENT says 27 October on both the signature and the stamp, so the chunk's date is off by a day and that is flagged here. IN-SCOPE (county office). NO DATE ON THIS FILING PARSES: Form A has an empty date cell on seven of eight rows and '10/23' with no year on the eighth; Form B writes every date as month/day with no year and carries a hand-written '2014' as a page header over the Date column. Under the contract a year is never lifted from a header or a report date, so every date is BLANK with the verbatim in the row note -- a human could promote the Form B dates to 2014 from that header, and this is the one place in the chunk where that judgement is available and was deliberately not taken. Form A's address column is entirely empty (no contributor addresses were recorded by the filer), so no privacy filtering was needed there; the candidate's home address, ZIP and home phone on the cover were discarded at read time. Neither schedule has an in-kind column, so in_kind is false throughout by construction.
